clips.title: Shafts
clips.alt: Cold shafts of light falling through deep water onto dark basalt rock, with a distant amber glow at the left edge.
clips.prompt: Anamorphic cinematic shot, slow steady push-in. Cold cyan volumetric shafts of light falling through deep water onto dark basalt rock, suspended particulate drifting, a single distant amber instrument glow at frame left.

clips.title: Manipulator
clips.alt: A submersible's manipulator arm under hard floodlights in black water, scratched yellow paint and hydraulic lines.
clips.prompt: Anamorphic cinematic shot, slow orbit. A submersible manipulator arm lit by hard floodlights in absolute black water, scratched yellow paint, hydraulic lines, marine snow drifting through the beams.

clips.title: Chimney
clips.alt: A hydrothermal vent chimney on the seafloor with black mineral smoke billowing upward and a faint orange glow at its base.
clips.prompt: Anamorphic cinematic shot, slow drift upward. A hydrothermal vent chimney on the deep seafloor, black mineral smoke billowing in dense plumes, faint orange heat glow at the base, blue floodlight raking across mineral crust.
